Subject: Need help with a wrongful termination case

Hello, my name is Smita Gowda. I am a 63-year-old civil engineer living in Ahmedabad. My employer M/s Saffron Technologies Pvt Ltd owes me Rs 20,60,000 after firing me, and the dismissal followed a one-sided domestic enquiry. My case number is Complaint No. 564/2019 in the Ahmedabad Labour Court. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on +91 95504 87670 or email smita.gowda@example.in.
